Subject: Vendor setup - docs and PO question

Hi Vanessa,

We're ready to activate VeloxStream as a supplier but procurement has a quick checklist before we can issue the PO. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs an Additional Insured endorsement on our COI? Our standard onboarding asks for: COI (GL + Auto + Employers), W-9, carrier name and policy numbers, and an endorsement adding VeloxStream as an Additional Insured and Waiver of Subrogation where applicable.

We can provide a signed W-9 and the COI via our vendor portal if that helps. We'd like to understand if Redwood can accept a conditional PO while endorsement is in progress.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Mendez
Vendor Onboarding Lead
VeloxStream

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Mendez <elena@veloxstream.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup - docs and PO question

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the clear list. Quick answers:

- Yes, we require a COI that shows GL, Auto, and Employers Liability.
- We need VeloxStream listed as Additional Insured on General Liability for work performed under the PO. The endorsement can be a CG 20 10 or equivalent wording.
- We accept a conditional PO for an initial onboarding period (30 days), but PO activation will remain on hold until Procurement confirms the endorsement and carrier limits.

Connor / Marissa — looping you in to confirm PO hold process and whether we need a primary insurer endorsement or any extra privacy addendum for this account.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Elena Mendez <elena@veloxstream.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup - docs and PO question

Thanks Vanessa / Elena — procurement here. We can issue a conditional PO that will allow invoices up to $25k while endorsement is outstanding, subject to the following being uploaded: signed W-9, COI showing current effective/expiry dates, and endorsement PDF naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured with policy number visible. Please include carrier name and limits on the COI field.

If the endorsement is not received within 30 days, the PO will be suspended and any unpaid invoices will be queued for review. For payment terms, we will follow standard net-30 once the PO is fully active.

Marissa — please confirm whether engineering can accept the near-term conditional PO for the kickoff integration work.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
